title: Application of Western Massachusetts Electric Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164 1/2 and the Company's tariff, M D.P.U. 499, for approval by the Depatment of Public Utilities of a change in the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of June, July, and August, 1986. The Oil Conservation Adjustment charge recovers the cost of conversion from oil-fired to coal-fired generation and its calulation is based on the respective costs of burning coal and oil.
